title: Test harness hardcodes port 19999 — fails if port already in use
description: spawn_test_listener and test harness code binds to a hardcoded port 19999. If that port is already in use on the test host, all integration tests fail with EADDRINUSE. Fix: bind to port 0 (OS-assigned ephemeral port) and read back the actual bound port for constructing test URLs.
